description:
After marrying her childhood betrothed and longtime crush, a woman senses something is terribly wrong: the man beside her is no longer the one she knew. She soon discovers another soul has taken residence within his body. As she struggles to untangle when the change occurred and whether the man she loved ever truly remained the possessing spirit’s obsession only deepens. Amid mounting confusion and desire, she uncovers the hidden truth behind her miraculous recovery from a deadly illness, setting the stage for a dark psychological romance between two souls and one fragile heart.

[Original Webtoon](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/dream_soul)
